flows.name: See the current public catalog immediately
preconditions: The site is built from the current source

steps.expected: The compact Wada masthead, registry description, 28 public plugins, 204 bundled skills, and catalog controls are visible without a marketing-art hero.
steps.evidence: Rendered DOM assertion and matching-viewport screenshot

steps.action: Press slash and type signal to system
steps.expected: Search receives focus and the registry narrows to Signal to System.
steps.evidence: Browser focus and visible result assertions

steps.expected: The search clears and the full registry returns.
steps.evidence: Browser input value and result count assertions

flows.name: Inspect and copy a verified install action

steps.action: Open Signal to System and copy its Codex install command
steps.expected: The detail record renders and the copy control confirms the exact Codex command.
steps.evidence: Button feedback and command text assertion

steps.expected: Only Codex and Claude Code install actions are present because Claude Cowork is not verified for this plugin.

flows.name: Use the registry on a narrow screen

steps.action: Open the homepage, Signal detail page, chooser, and one skill guide
steps.expected: The masthead, controls, rows, chooser, skill guide, and install commands remain readable and touch-usable without horizontal overflow.

flows.name: Switch and persist the reading theme
preconditions: Paper is the default theme and local storage is empty

steps.action: Switch from Paper to Sumi on a Signal route
steps.expected: The control communicates its state and the exact Sumi tokens apply without changing content or chooser state.
steps.evidence: ARIA state and computed token assertions

steps.expected: Sumi remains active from device-local storage, then can be returned to Paper.

flows.name: Respect host support boundaries
preconditions: All-host, Codex-only, Claude-only, and Signal records exist

steps.expected: Each page renders only the installation actions documented for that plugin's supported hosts.

flows.name: Preserve the public export and privacy boundary
preconditions: The generated catalog reflects repository source

steps.action: Check every public record, both exports, and the excluded compatibility route
steps.expected: All 28 public plugin routes and both exports work, the deprecated Matt package is absent from every public surface, and its route returns 404.
steps.evidence: Rendered-route suite, export scan, and anonymous request assertions

flows.name: Choose the right Signal to System skill
preconditions: The Signal to System detail page is visible

steps.action: Choose the need to find current changes and useful links
steps.expected: The chooser recommends Signal Scout, explains the fit, and shows a copyable illustrative request.
The Signal Scout page opens and preserves the chooser's recommendation context in plain language.

flows.name: Inspect every Signal to System skill
preconditions: Signal to System is in the public catalog

steps.action: Open each of the ten skill links
steps.expected: Every route renders the correct stage, purpose, fit, boundaries, illustrative request, working method, useful result, and inspectable GitHub source.
steps.evidence: Static route and rendered content assertions

flows.name: Keep examples honest
preconditions: The Signal detail and skill pages are rendered

steps.expected: Prompts are labeled illustrative, useful-result descriptions are expectations rather than proof, and no fabricated testimonial or completed outcome is presented.
steps.evidence: Copy scan and rendered page assertions
